candidates.snippet: @CandyPhlipper And it lost a lot of its relevance to the Saudis as they ship oil up north towards the SUMED and Suez Canal. From there, it reaches the Western markets. The Saudis have had this issue for many years now. It's nothing new.

People are now saying that the Houthis control the Red Sea. Whether that is still the case or not is yet to be seen, but they certainly do not control the Suez Canal or the SUMED network. Yes, imagine that: The Red Sea has another exit. Who knew? https://t.co/bQskLeRs6S
@TheNewsProfesor @readyinafewdayz That is correct, and they are the ONLY reason right now why Iranian oil production hasn't slipped straight to zero.
